meaning.en: (southwest) A man who herds cattle; cowboy.
meaning.vi: (tây nam) Một người chăn gia súc; cao bồi.

meaning.en: (US, Southwestern US) A cowboy; a herdsman.
meaning.vi: (Hoa Kỳ, Tây Nam Hoa Kỳ) Một cao bồi; một người chăn gia súc.

sentences.en: In 1870 a steamer named "The Vaquero" made its first trip to a marshy lagoon for trading.

sentences.en: By the time I had done the obligatory 20-minute brushwork on Vaquero, my arms ached.
